Data.Description: Snapshot commands for capturing and inspecting application DOM data.

Options.Description: Project directory to match against running Studio instances
Governance policy to judge this invocation by where the signed-in tenant has none

Subcommands.Name: capture
Subcommands.Description: List top-level targets (windows and browser tabs), or drill into one to extract its element tree.

Subcommands.Name: load
Subcommands.Description: Load snapshot artifacts already written to a folder back into the reference cache, without reading the live UI

Subcommands.Name: semantic-find
Subcommands.Description: Find elements in a window or browser tab by describing them in natural language. Recommended when the app is not supported by the tree-based snapshot flow.

GlobalOptions.Description: JMESPath expression applied to the Data field of the response envelope
Write logs to file instead of stderr
